commands.command: set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED='a15877bdb338a54d1bc30885b876c9e8f1459494'; SERIAL='RFCT70L7E8J'; PKG='io.blueeye'; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; test "$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {n++} END {print n+0}')" -eq 1; test "$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}' | head -n1)" = "$SERIAL"; model=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r'); echo device_model=$model; case "$model" in SM-S906*) ;; *) exit 3;; esac; dump(){ adb -s "$SERIAL" shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/tracker-alert-v3.xml >/dev/null; adb -s "$SERIAL" exec-out cat /sdcard/tracker-alert-v3.xml > /tmp/tracker-alert-v3.xml; }; tap_node(){ attr=$1; value=$2; dump; coords=$(python3 tools/ui-smoke/ui_node.py /tmp/tracker-alert-v3.xml "$attr" "$value"); adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input tap $coords; sleep 1; }; master_state(){ xmllint --xpath 'string((//node[@checkable="true" and @enabled="true"])[1]/@checked)' /tmp/tracker-alert-v3.xml 2>/dev/null; }; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am force-stop "$PKG" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am start -W -n "$PKG/.MainActivity" >/dev/null; sleep 2; tap_node content-desc Menu; tap_node text Settings; tap_node text 'Alerts & Collection'; dump; before_master=$(master_state); echo detection_before=$before_master; test "$before_master" = false; master=$(python3 tools/ui-smoke/ui_node.py /tmp/tracker-alert-v3.xml text 'Tracker Detection' --nearest-checkable); adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input tap $master; sleep 1; dump; enabled_master=$(master_state); echo detection_after_enable=$enabled_master; test "$enabled_master" = true; test_coords=''; for i in 1 2 3; do dump; if test_coords=$(python3 tools/ui-smoke/ui_node.py /tmp/tracker-alert-v3.xml text 'Test alert' 2>/dev/null); then break; fi; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input swipe 500 1750 500 650 350; sleep 1; done; test -n "$test_coords"; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input tap $test_coords; sleep 1; notif_before=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys notification --noredact | grep -c 'BlueEye test alert' || true); echo test_notification_before_disable=$notif_before; test "$notif_before" -ge 1; uid=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys package "$PKG" | awk -F= '/userId=/{gsub(/\r/,"",$2); print $2; exit}'); echo package_uid=$uid; echo '--- audio-before ---'; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys audio | grep -i -E "io.blueeye|uid[ :=]+$uid|USAGE_ALARM|state[:=]started" | head -n 60 || true; master=''; for i in 1 2 3; do dump; if master=$(python3 tools/ui-smoke/ui_node.py /tmp/tracker-alert-v3.xml text 'Tracker Detection' --nearest-checkable 2>/dev/null); then break; fi; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input swipe 500 650 500 1800 350; sleep 1; done; test -n "$master"; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input tap $master; sleep 1; notif_after=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys notification --noredact | grep -c 'BlueEye test alert' || true); echo test_notification_after_disable=$notif_after; test "$notif_after" -eq 0; dump; final_master=$(master_state); echo detection_final=$final_master; test "$final_master" = false; echo '--- audio-after ---'; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys audio | grep -i -E "io.blueeye|uid[ :=]+$uid|USAGE_ALARM|state[:=]started" | head -n 60 || true; echo PHASE3_ALERT_S22_DETECTION_OFF_ACCEPTANCE_PASS
commands.output:
* daemon not running; starting now at tcp:5037
* daemon started successfully
device_model=SM-S906B
detection_before=false
detection_after_enable=true
test_notification_before_disable=0
